## Wave 2 Summary

This wave **comprehensively expands** `Phononic-Substrate-Geometry.md` to read as if authored today (S93-era) with full knowledge of the whole project. The document is the framework's substrate-as-resonator thesis — the substrate IS a high-Q resonator whose internal structure is the Dirac operator `D_K` on Jensen-deformed SU(3) fibered with the finite algebra `A_F = ℂ ⊕ ℍ ⊕ M_3(ℂ)`; its eigenvalue spectrum (155,984 modes at L_max=10, 78,080 unique) is the content of physics; spectral moments `a_0/a_2/a_4` are the cosmological constant / gravity / gauge couplings.

It was authored at the **post-S84 resonator reframe** and has NEVER integrated the **~9 sessions S85→S93** of substrate-geometry development. The DOMAIN this wave surveys + expands is **the substrate's geometry as resonator**: SU(3) topology, the spectral triple `(A_F ⊗ C^∞(SU(3)), H_F ⊗ L²(SU(3),S), D_K)`, the Jensen deformation moduli geometry, the Peter-Weyl decomposition + Casimir/Dirac-spectrum structure, the Seeley-DeWitt `a_n` moments, the spectral-action variational principle, and the cross-pillar geometry bridges (§VII registry). The deliverable is a substantially EXPANDED document; drift-fixing (the `S84-era` counts, the A_F-Birkhoff status, the M_KK §13 inconsistency) is folded in as the QA layer.

**The wave is NOT a linear session read.** Each load-bearing claim is a synthesis surface drawing on results scattered across ~93 only-peripherally-connected sessions; the knowledge MCP (`search_knowledge → trace_entity → list_entities → get_constant → query_entity`) reconstructs the current aggregate state of the DOMAIN in a heavy survey pass (context §5). The wave is owned by the document's author-specialist (`tesla-resonance`) because the SU(3)/Peter-Weyl/principal-bundle geometry carries legitimately-distinct quantities (the τ-quartet; the eigenvalue-count multiplicity convention; the A_F-uniqueness verdict-vs-theorem status) that a naive find-and-replace would corrupt — only the domain author mining the evidence chain can both adjudicate STALE-vs-distinct AND write the new geometry sections in the document's own register.

**Three gates**, per context §4 architecture (`SURVEY → EXPAND → VERIFY`), center of mass at G2:
- `WX-W2-1 AGGREGATE-DOMAIN-SURVEY` (trigger AUDIT) — the comprehensiveness engine: map the geometry domain across ~93 sessions + enumerate the gap with KB citations.
- `WX-W2-2 COMPREHENSIVE-EXPANSION` (trigger VERIFY) — **the deliverable**: integrate the G1 gap (new geometry sections, deepened spectral-triple/moment treatment, new bridges); reconcile A_F-Birkhoff + refresh the "84 sessions / 1,600+ scripts / 112+ results" counts as QA. A minimal/cosmetic edit FAILS.
- `WX-W2-3 RECONCILE+VERIFY` (trigger VERIFY) — QA over the expanded document: every claim current, framing-compliant (IS-not-IN), provenance-traced, `a_n^{regulator}`-tagged.

All three emit the canonical dual-SHA verdict line + WP section via a small mechanical closure script, so the v3 closure ladder + `_yaml_gate_validator.py` stay intact for prose/expansion gates. The intellectual work — the domain survey, the gap analysis, the comprehensive expansion writing — is the executor's, recorded in the WP + survey/gap artifacts + the expanded document itself.

**Geometry cross-consultation directive (binding on the executor, all three gates)**: the SU(3)/principal-bundle/Peter-Weyl/Casimir/Dirac-spectrum claims (§2 cavity topology, §3 wave-guide, §5 eigenmode census, §6 spectral action) MUST be cross-checked against `baptista-spacetime-analyst`-domain KB entries (`session-40-baptista-collab`, `session-46-wave*`, `session-56-dirac-collab`, `session-60/61` heat-kernel waves, `s86-mellin-cone-repair-or-no-go.md`). The executor runs `search_knowledge`/`trace_entity` on the SU(3)/Jensen/Dirac-spectrum evidence chain and cites the Baptista-domain entry alongside the resonator-voice claim. The owner is the document author; the geometry is cross-consulted, not delegated.

# ---- Verdict rubric ----
PASS_meaning: "The substrate-geometry domain is mapped across the pertinent KB entity classes (the seven sub-domains a–g of machinery_pin_map are each surveyed) AND the gap analysis is enumerated with a KB citation + where-it-belongs line per row. The comprehensiveness engine has run: G2 now has a complete, cited target-set to integrate. This is the state that makes a COMPREHENSIVE (not minimal) expansion possible."
FAIL_meaning: "The survey only re-checked the doc's existing claims (claim-by-claim audit), OR ≥1 gap row lacks a KB citation, OR ≥1 of the seven sub-domains was not surveyed. The comprehensiveness engine did not fire — G2 would produce a partial/cosmetic expansion. Route to re-dispatch with the un-surveyed sub-domain(s) named."
INFO_meaning: "Survey complete and cited, but a sub-domain returned a structurally ambiguous state (e.g., a verdict-vs-theorem split like A_F-Birkhoff Q1, or a still-open question like cube-3 Q6) that G2 must reconcile-in-text rather than simply integrate. The INFO flags the reconciliation items for G2's QA layer."

## Wave 2 → Wave 9 Decision Point

Wave 2 is INDEPENDENT (no W2-internal upstream-prereq chain). Its outputs feed **W9** (cross-document consistency + coverage closeout, owner `gen-physicist`), the only dependent wave (context §3, §4):

| W2 gate | Verdict pattern | W9 downstream action |
|:--------|:----------------|:---------------------|
| `WX-W2-1` | PASS | W9 SHARED-CONSTANT-MATRIX consumes the W2 state-of-domain map's constant census (M_KK, τ_fold, Δ_BCS, 155,984, four-speed hierarchy, seven-frequency comb) for cross-document consistency. |
| `WX-W2-1` | FAIL/INFO | W9 COVERAGE-CONSISTENCY flags the un-surveyed sub-domain(s) as a cross-document coverage gap; W2 re-dispatch precedes W9. |
| `WX-W2-2` | PASS | W9 verifies the EXPANDED `Phononic-Substrate-Geometry.md` is mutually consistent with the other 7 expanded docs (esp. shared geometry↔cosmology constants with W3 `Phononic-to-Cosmos.md`, shared causality↔geometry with W4 `Phononic-C-Causality.md`, shared crystal-geometry with W8 viz). |
| `WX-W2-2` | INFO (scoped-out set) | W9 COVERAGE-CONSISTENCY checks each scoped-out gap row landed in its target wave's document (e.g., Q7 cosmology in W3); a scoped-out item missing from BOTH W2 and its target = a cross-document coverage hole. |
| `WX-W2-3` | PASS | W9 treats `Phononic-Substrate-Geometry.md` as QA-closed; the SHARED-CONSTANT-MATRIX uses its values as one authoritative row. |
| `WX-W2-3` | FAIL | W9 SHARED-CONSTANT-MATRIX must NOT consume the doc's values until the defect set is fixed; W2 fix-in-session precedes W9. |

**Shared-constant hand-off to W9** (the values W9's matrix cross-checks against the other 7 docs): `M_KK = 7.4287e16 GeV`, `τ_fold = 0.19`, `Δ_BCS = 0.46425`, `N_DK = 155,984 (78,080 unique) at L_max=10`, four-speed hierarchy `{1.000, 0.485, 0.399, [0.019,0.032]}`, seven-frequency comb `{0.070, 0.107, 0.168, 0.744, 1.430, 1.464, 8.27}`, `dS/dτ|_fold = +58,673`, `KO-dim = 6`, `A_F = ℂ⊕ℍ⊕M_3(ℂ)`.

## Wave 2 Machinery-Enumeration Pin

Aggregate of all three gate `machinery_pin_map` entries (per `epistemic-discipline.md §"Pre-Registration Completeness"` PRDR; read by `_yaml_gate_validator.py` for sig_4 of the v3 closure ladder):

| Gate | scheme | convention | L_max | GPU_path | Survey/expansion target |
|:-----|:-------|:-----------|:------|:---------|:------------------------|
| `WX-W2-1-AGGREGATE-DOMAIN-SURVEY` | aggregate-domain-survey | substrate-geometry-domain-S93-era-state-map | N/A | N/A | seven sub-domains a–g (cavity / wave-guide / moduli / eigenmode / spectral-action / bridges / open-questions); gap analysis with KB citations |
| `WX-W2-2-COMPREHENSIVE-EXPANSION` | comprehensive-expansion | additive-synthesis-authorial-voice-IS-not-IN-S93-era | N/A | N/A | G1 gap_analysis (E1–E9 + finds); comprehensive floor ≥4 new + ≥3 deepened + ≥3 recast/QA |
| `WX-W2-3-RECONCILE-VERIFY` | reconcile-verify | current-framed-traced-tagged-4-tuple-S93-era | N/A | N/A | doc_post full; DEFECT_SET = {stale ∪ unframed ∪ untraced ∪ untagged}, PASS = empty |

**Shared pins (all three gates)**: `canonical_constants_snapshot = computations/_shared/canonical_constants.py`; `knowledge_db = tools/knowledge.db`; `document_SHA = <computed-at-runtime>`; `random_seed = N/A — deterministic`; `N_eval/scan_range/step_size = N/A — survey/expansion/verification gates` (these are prose/synthesis gates per context §4: PASS predicates are coverage/integration/defect-emptiness, NOT numerical thresholds; the closure script is mechanical — dual-SHA + verdict — per context §4 final paragraph).

**Closure-script discipline (all three)**: each gate's closure script (`sx_w2_{slug}.py`) (a) imports from `canonical_constants` (per `math-scripts.md` S34+), (b) loads doc_pre/doc_post + the canonical snapshot + the survey/gap artifacts, (c) computes the dual SHA (`audit_sha256` over the audit_discriminators inputs; `content_sha256` over the content_sha256 inputs), (d) appends via the canonical `append_verdict` helper to `computations/session-x/sx_gate_verdicts.txt` (NOT a raw write; per `gate-verdicts.md` canonical path), (e) writes the dual-SHA companion comment row. The `.npz`/`.png` are `optional: true` (no numerical output mandated for prose gates); the survey/gap/ledger artifacts (state-of-domain map, gap analysis, defect-set ledger) live in the WP sections + optional `.npz` sidecar.

## Wave 2 Input-SHA Ledger

Every input file the wave's gates consume, with expected SHA-256 (per `gate-verdicts.md`; static files get precomputed hashes, dynamic inputs marked `<computed-at-runtime>`; cross-checked at plan-freeze by `_plan_upstream_pin_validator.py`):

| Input file | Consumed by | SHA-256 | Note |
|:-----------|:------------|:--------|:-----|
| `sessions/framework/Phononic-Substrate-Geometry.md` | W2-1 (pre), W2-2 (pre), W2-3 (post) | `<computed-at-runtime>` | the document under expansion; the SAME path is doc_pre (G1/G2 input) and doc_post (G3 input) — its content_sha256 CHANGES between G2-pre and G3-post (that delta IS the expansion); each gate captures the SHA at its own runtime |
| `computations/_shared/canonical_constants.py` | all three | `<computed-at-runtime>` | canonical snapshot; large + frequently updated, so runtime-pinned per `gate-verdicts.md` dynamic-input convention |
| `tools/knowledge.db` | all three | `<computed-at-runtime>` | knowledge MCP backing store; runtime-pinned (rebuilt by `/weave --update`) |
| `computations/session-x/sx_w2_aggregate_domain_survey.npz` | W2-2 (G1→G2 hand-off: the gap analysis) | `<computed-at-runtime>` | INTRA-WAVE dependency: G2 consumes G1's state-of-domain map + gap analysis; pinned at G2 runtime after G1 lands |

**Intra-wave ordering**: G1 (survey) → G2 (expansion, consumes G1's gap artifact) → G3 (verify, consumes G2's doc_post). The three gates run sequentially; G2's input `sx_w2_aggregate_domain_survey.npz` and G3's input doc_post are produced upstream within the wave, so both are `<computed-at-runtime>` (verified at each gate's execution). No EXTERNAL (prior-session) verdict is a hard prerequisite — S85→S93 results are mined read-only via the knowledge MCP as survey inputs, not gated as upstream verdict-pins (consistent with the "Wave 2 Decision Point Prerequisites: None" footer).
